task: Fix exactly one remaining PR #601 acceptance blocker on migration/svelte-go-live-candidate: the Psycopg 3 / PostgreSQL 18 IndeterminateDatatype failure in scripts/repair_body_contract.py when fetch_missing_bodies_only_batch starts with cursor_after=None. The failing SQL is MISSING_BODIES_ONLY_FETCH_REPAIR_BATCH_SQL and currently contains `AND (%s IS NULL OR s.id64 > %s)`, producing an untyped `$1 IS NULL`. Make the nullable pagination cursor explicitly typed as bigint (or an equivalently narrow Psycopg 3-safe solution) while preserving the existing keyset pagination, ordering, FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED, batching, missing-bodies-only scope, and all data-integrity behavior. Do not change product code, apps/web, Finder/Babylon/Inspect, architecture, NATS, Redis/Valkey, release/deployment scope, schema, migrations, production infrastructure, or production data. Add or adjust only a focused regression test if needed to lock the typed nullable cursor behavior. Run the focused repair_body_contract unit tests available on the branch and, if the governed environment has the confirmed disposable Postgres opt-in/DSN, run `tests/test_data_trust_runtime.py::test_body_contract_repair_and_reconcile_restore_clean_invariants`; otherwise leave that integration proof to the existing isolated CI job. Keep the diff minimal and report exact files/tests changed. Do not fix unrelated failures or refactor adjacent code.
